model_contract.factor_full: Each factor-side ridge receives every available feature from the frozen full SPM bank for that side.
model_contract.overall_full_spm: The overall offense and defense models use the frozen histogram-GBM and ridge learners with the identical available full feature banks.
model_contract.teammate_context: The context variants add six leave-one-player-out, possession-weighted same-team fields per side.
model_contract.missing_values: Training-fold median with missing indicators for ridge; the frozen SPM learners retain their existing missing-value pipeline.
model_contract.sample_weight: Square root of factor exposure for factor heads and square root of minimum-side possessions for normal RAPM.

selection_rule: Select factor-head ridge penalties using 2024 fits scored on 2025. Do not tune the frozen overall SPM learners. Refit on 2024-25 and diagnose once on reused 2026.
primary_comparison: 2026 normal-RAPM weighted RMSE and correlation for full overall SPM with and without teammate context.
secondary_comparison: 2026 factor-target R-squared and reconstructed normal-RAPM performance for sparse and full feature banks, with and without teammate context.
stopping_rules: Do not change features, learners, alphas, or context definitions after inspecting 2026.
Do not call teammate context player skill.
Do not call this a complete defense ceiling while the eight scorer-matchup fields and 2026 DFG sources are absent.
